result:
I've implemented round 116, but it hit one of B's stop conditions: 3 of the 370 targeted tests fail, in `track-group-mix-ui.test.tsx`. That file isn't in my granted list, so I didn't edit it, and B needs to rule on it.

**Why they fail.** UM3, UM5 and UM9 move the lane Volume slider using the old linear values. On the new dB range those values mean something else:
- UM3: a −50 px drag is now −30 dB, so it stores 10^(−30/20) instead of 0.5 (l.480/482, and again at l.522).
- UM5: `'0.5'` is clamped to 0 dB (l.569/571).
- UM9: `'0.7'` is clamped to 0 dB (l.657/660).

Each one has a suggested dB replacement in the report. UM5 l.575 checks a combined track × group gain rather than a stored volume, so B also needs to decide how that line should be matched.

**What changed**
- New `app/lib/arrangement/track-volume-db.ts`: converts between the stored linear volume and dB, and formats the text (`−4.4 dB`, `−∞ dB`, `+0.0 dB`).
- `ArrangementLane.tsx`, Volume fader only:
  - The slider now runs from −60 to 0 dB in 0.1 dB steps; −60 means −∞ and stores exactly 0.
  - It has an `aria-valuetext`, and the readout shows dB with the full text as its `title`.
  - The readout widened from `w-9` to `w-10`.
  - The stored value stays linear, so the context, model, schedule, graph and export are unchanged.
- **Exact Undo:** the lane remembers the exact starting value when a drag begins. A drag that returns to its start writes it back unchanged (`0.6` stays `0.6`, no history entry).
- New `track-volume-db.test.tsx` (TV1–TV11, 11 tests).
- 65 scale-only line edits in 9 of the 11 granted test files; `pan-release-recovery` and `pending-status` needed none.
  - The edit and test counts per file are unchanged from `d5de68f`.
  - In four places the old linear value was being clamped to 0 dB, so those tests passed only by accident; they now use the intended value.
- New doc 100, and doc 099 line 4 updated.

**Checks**
- **Typecheck:** passed.
- **Lint:** passed. Biome on the changed files is clean; I fixed 4 formatting spots by hand, without `--write`.
- **Targeted vitest:** 18 of 19 files and 367 of 370 tests pass; the 3 failures are the ones above. The full suite and `npm run verify` were not run (that's the gate's job).
- **Mutation proof:** each of m1–m6 turns its target test red, and the files were restored and checksum-verified each time.
- **Frozen list:** OK at start and end. The protected auth and purchase files are unchanged.

**Browser sanity probe** (Playwright on `/studio-lab`, 1440×900 and 1280×720, default lane height only; not C acceptance):

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Slider, normal lane | 107 px | 103 px |
| Slider, lane inside a group | 95 px | 91 px |
| Readout width (scrollWidth/clientWidth) | 36/36 | 40/40, one line |
| Header | 224 px | 224 px |

In real Chromium, Home gives −∞ and ArrowRight then gives −59.9. There were no console, hydration or network errors.

**Code review:** the code-reviewer subagent scored the diff 8/10 with nothing Medium or higher apart from the stop above. I added the extra edge cases it suggested (values above 1, +∞, −0). Its architecture note for B: the drag hook knows the starting value but doesn't share it, so in stage 3b it could tell the fader when it's back at the start. Otherwise the group and Master faders would each copy this lane's workaround.

**Decisions for B**
1. **0 dB text:** the spec says to use Master's formatter, but that prints `0.0 dB` at zero, while the acceptance rows require `+0.0 dB`. I followed the acceptance rows, so at 0 dB the lane reads `+0.0` and Master reads `0.0 dB`.
2. **Readout read twice:** screen readers hear the lane readout after the slider's own text, as they did with the old `%` readout. I left it unchanged and propose it as a deferred Low.

The full report is `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-116.md`, with every changed line (old → new, with the formula) and the next C checks. C still needs to check layout at the smaller lane heights, which I didn't probe. No commits or pushes; the `a-browse.json` state file wasn't written because the probe needed no saved state.
